GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is used to ensure that extracted client data complies with FCA requirements before it is saved to Salesforce.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query involves compliance validation, ensure the extracted data meets FCA requirements before proceeding.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only validate that the extracted data aligns with FCA compliance requirements. You aren't responsible for extracting or saving the data.
